_purpose: Maps GSS variables to construct-level batteries. Used by R1 (battery-level exclusion) — when predicting any item in a battery, the entire battery is dropped from the persona prompt for that prediction. Mirrors Park v2's BFI whole-trait-block hold-out rule (PDF p.37 SI §5).
_design_notes: Battery boundaries are domain decisions, not statistical clusters. We pick the set such that within-battery items share question wording, response scale, and underlying construct closely enough that they are 'effectively asked twice' relative to the predicted item.
Items NOT listed in any battery are 'singletons' — they get no battery exclusion (R1 is a no-op for them).

Civil-liberties items are split into 3 batteries by target group (atheists / racists / communists) rather than collapsed into one mega-battery. Rationale: knowing R's view of racists' free-speech tells you very little about R's view of atheists' free-speech, but knowing R's view of one racist-related question tells you a lot about R's view of the others.
Locked decisions (Joyce 2026-05-08): R3 (whole-attitudinal-bin hold-out) NOT implemented; R1 alone is the structural defense; R2 (regression baseline) provides the partition test.

abortion.construct: Conditions under which legal abortion should be available. All 7 items are binary YES/NO and share canonical 1972-onward GSS wording.

confidence_in_institutions.construct: Institutional confidence battery — same 3-point Likert scale (great deal / only some / hardly any) across all 13 institutions.

national_priorities.construct: Spending priority battery — same 3-point scale (too little / about right / too much) across all 15 domains.

racial_inequality_perception.construct: Causes-of-racial-inequality + group-wealth-attribution + affirmative-action-perception. Tightly correlated cluster covering the same construct (perceived racial inequality).

gender_role_attitudes.construct: Gender-role attitudes battery — same 4-point agree/disagree scale on 5 gender-role propositions.

civil_lib_atheists.construct: Civil-liberty extension to anti-religionists (free speech + teaching).

civil_lib_racists.construct: Civil-liberty extension to racists (free speech + teaching + library access).

civil_lib_communists.construct: Civil-liberty extension to communists (free speech + employment + library access).

sexual_morality.construct: Same 4-point ALWAYS/NOT WRONG scale on extramarital and same-sex relations.

moral_legalization.construct: Should-be-legal stance on marijuana and pornography — both are 'should the state regulate this?' items.

adolescent_sex_policy.construct: Adolescent sex policy — birth-control access for teens + sex-education in schools.

religious_belief.construct: Personal religious / spiritual belief intensity (5 distinct measures of the same latent).

economic_help.construct: Government redistribution + economic-mobility beliefs. Tightly correlated 'redistribution attitude' cluster.

police_use_of_force.construct: When may police strike a citizen? — three scenarios with same 1-2 scale.
